t.zh: 工作台能存、能读像素，却说不出这些数从哪里来：场景里的一点，落到图上的哪个位置？相机台从一台理想的针孔相机起步：一点射出的光穿过针孔，落在离针孔 f 的<wiki-ref to="image-plane"></wiki-ref>上，f 叫<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>。台上把像平面画在针孔前面，像是正的。
t.en: The workbench can store and read pixels but cannot say where the numbers come from: where in the image does a point of the scene land? The camera bench starts with an ideal pinhole camera: light from a point passes the hole and lands on the <wiki-ref to="image-plane"></wiki-ref> at distance f from it, f being the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>. The bench draws the plane in front of the hole, so the image is upright.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一点穿过针孔，落在像平面的什么位置？同一个物体离得越远，像怎样变？两个任务各只开一个旋钮：先横向移动一点，再前后移动一支箭。像落到圆圈标出的目标上才算对。
t.en: This level asks: where on the image plane does a point land after passing the hole, and how does the image change as the object moves away? Each of the two tasks opens one knob: first move a point sideways, then move an arrow in depth. It is right when the image lands on the circled target.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>：像的位置和大小按 f/Z 缩放；讲义把像平面画在针孔前面，只是坐标约定。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>: where the image lands and how big it is scale with f/Z; drawing the plane in front of the hole is only a coordinate convention.

brief.zh: f = 2、Z = 4：横向移动这一点，让它的像落在 u = 1 的标记上。
brief.en: With f = 2 and Z = 4, move the point sideways so its image lands on the mark at u = 1.

hint.zh: 顺着画出的光线看：它从物体出发，穿过针孔，停在像平面上。
hint.en: Follow the drawn ray: it leaves the object, passes the hole and stops on the image plane.

why.zh: 把物体放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：像不在物体的高度上，它按 f/Z 缩小了。
why.en: With the point at X = 1 its image lands only at u = 0.5: the image is not at the object's height, it is shrunk by f/Z.

brief.zh: 箭高 2、f = 2：只前后移动这支箭，让像高等于 0.5。
brief.en: An arrow 2 tall, f = 2: move the arrow only in depth so its image is 0.5 tall.

hint.zh: 先看箭在 Z = 2 和 Z = 4 时，像各有多高。
hint.en: First see how tall the image is with the arrow at Z = 2 and at Z = 4.

why.zh: 以为距离每加 1，像高就少同样一截：像高按 1/Z 变化，Z = 5 时是 0.8。
why.en: Assuming each unit of depth takes the same amount off the image: the height goes as 1/Z, and at Z = 5 it is 0.8.
